subject: Go‑live orchestration: attendee roles, access items, and meeting access
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Taylor <alex.taylor@bluepeakhealth.com>, Onboarding Team <onboarding@bluepeakhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Go‑live orchestration: attendee roles, access items, and meeting access

Alex / BluePeak team —

Thanks for moving quickly here. We want to lock the go‑live coordination session for the week of Nov 16 so engineering, ops, and your product owners have a single bridge to validate cutover steps. Please confirm one of the two options below:

- Tue, Nov 17 — 10:00–11:00 PT (preferred for Redwood east coast + BluePeak PMs)
- Thu, Nov 19 — 14:00–15:00 PT (preferred for BluePeak engineering)

Primary goals for the call (attached agenda):
- Finalize cutover checklist and rollback conditions
- Confirm who will own each verification step (DB read, API smoke, telemetry checks)
- Verify access (SFTP, DB read‑only, console) and who still needs credentials
- Confirm support rotation and escalation bridge for the first 24h

Quick asks for your team before we send the calendar:
1) Please confirm which option above works and list the attendees + their roles.
2) Provide any IPs or firewall rules that need to be whitelisted for Redwood bridges.
3) If you need a private breakout (security/keys), flag that and we will schedule a sidecall.

Attachments: bluepeak-go-live-agenda.pdf (agenda), access-roles-checklist.csv (simple matrix)

Thanks — I’ll assemble the final attendee matrix once you confirm.

Diego Fernandez
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
D: +1 (415) 555‑0198
From: Alex Taylor <alex.taylor@bluepeakhealth.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Onboarding Team <onboarding@bluepeakhealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Go‑live orchestration: attendee roles, access items, and meeting access

Diego —

Thanks, Tue Nov 17 10:00 PT works for us. Attendee list below (high level):
- Alex Taylor — Program Lead (BluePeak) — will own product acceptance signoff
- Priya Shah — Lead Engineer (BluePeak) — DB/API checks
- Ryan Cho — Security Ops (BluePeak) — firewall/IP, keys, HSM questions
- Onboarding Team — multiple (observe / take notes)

We do need a private breakout to discuss KMS/HSM access. Can that be a separate 30‑minute slot immediately after the main session? Also one ask: can Redwood share a minimal runbook for the first‑hour post‑cutover (smoke checks we can follow)?

On the firewall front, we will send a separate note from our infra team with the three IPs to whitelist.

Alex

Folks — forwarding Alex’s confirmation. We’re locking Tue Nov 17 10:00 PT. Action items before I publish the invite: 

- Marissa: can you own the main bridge (coordinator) and confirm the Zoom/webex room?
- Jonas: please prepare the 10‑minute runbook summary (first‑hour checklist) and attach to the calendar.
- Monica: I need the engineering point of contact for escalation for the first 24h (name + mobile).
- Kimberly: please preseed the access checklist with the items Alex’s infra team will send (SFTP, DB read, KMS access) and mark any outstanding items.

I’ve attached an updated attendee matrix (access-roles-checklist.csv) — please update and send back by EOD so I can send calendar invites to BluePeak. Also we’ll plan a 30m private security breakout after the main session (10:35–11:05 PT).

Diego
